input_schema.description:
`source.add`: a source of `kind` capturing one target, on top of the program scene.
A `text` source (protocol 1.75, ADR-0129 decision 8) has no target: `adapter` and
`target` may be left out and are ignored, and `text` is what it shows.

adapter.description: The adapter that listed the target (empty for `text`).

global.description:
Add it as a global source of the studio's canvas instead (protocol 1.10,
ADR-0065): shown and heard in every scene; `scene` is then not allowed.

name.description: Its name; `null` lets the server pick one.

path.description:
The file of an `image` or `media` source instead of a target (protocol 1.100):
a local absolute path; any other path needs the irreversible-actions permission.

scene.description: The scene it is placed in (protocol 1.9); absent: the program scene.

stamp.description:
The shape of a `color` source, centred (protocol 1.100). Not allowed for other
kinds.

target.description: The target's id for that adapter (empty for `text`).

text.description:
The text a `text` source shows (protocol 1.75); absent: "Text". Not allowed for
other kinds.

url.description:
The address of a `browser` page (protocol 1.100); `""` adds a page that waits
for one.

with_audio.description:
Also add the sound that belongs to the picture (protocol 1.26, ADR-0096): a
display's system sound without RBS's own sound, a window's application sound.
Default false; the picture and its sound are one undo step.

id.description: Its id, unique in the collection.

settings.description: Its settings as it runs them on air (every field of a built-in type).

Glide.description: Collection or source glide timing (protocol 1.35, ADR-0100).

easing.description: Slide easing; fade-ins use the duration only.

GlideEasing.description: How a slide maps unit time (protocol 1.35, ADR-0100). Fade-ins stay linear.

Heard.description: The volume and mute a source is heard at (protocol 1.48, ADR-0091).

ItemLayout.description:
A picture's place on the canvas (protocol 1.3): the layout the studio's canvas
shows.

crop.description: Source pixels cut from the left, top, right and bottom.

position.description: Top-left corner of the unrotated box, canvas pixels.

rotation.description: Clockwise rotation in degrees about the box centre.

scroll.description:
The picture moving through the box (protocol 1.94, ADR-0150); absent when it
does not scroll.

size.description: Box size in canvas pixels; negative flips.

ItemScroll.description:
A picture moving through its item's box (protocol 1.94, ADR-0150). Lengths and
speed in the item's box units (canvas pixels for an item on the canvas); defaults
are left out.

fade.description: Soft edges at both ends of the box, 0 to 2048 (0).

gap.description: Empty units between two copies, 0 to 16384 (0).

ramp_ms.description: How long a pause, resume or speed change eases, 0 to 5000 ms (300).

ItemStyle.description:
Shape, border and shadow of a picture (ADR-0053). Lengths are in the item's box
units (canvas pixels for an item on the canvas); colours are `#rrggbb` or
`#rrggbbaa`, sRGB with straight alpha. `{}` is the plain picture.

border.description: A line inside the shape's edge.

shadow.description: A shadow under the shape; saved, not drawn yet.

MonitorMode.description: Whether a source is heard on the monitor output (protocol 1.30, ADR-0097).

oneOf.description: Monitored and taken off the stream and recordings while a monitor plays.

PictureForm.description:
The form of a marked picture in a source row (protocol 1.52). The request side is
`request::VideoAs`; this one reads a later server's value as `other`.

oneOf.description: Images for a still source, a video file otherwise.
A form this client does not know (a later minor).

RecordTracks.description: The feeds of a source marked to record separately (protocol 1.52).

ScrollDirection.description:
Which way a scrolling picture moves in its box (protocol 1.94, ADR-0150), in the
box's own frame.

oneOf.description: Right to left, like a news ticker.

ScrollRepeat.description: How often a scrolling picture crosses its box (ADR-0150).

oneOf.description: Once, then the box stays empty.

ScrollReturn.description:
What a scroll's run does when a shown scene draws its item again (protocol 1.99,
ADR-0152 decision 6).

oneOf.description: Where it would be had it kept moving, while the item's source stays placed.
Where the picture is placed without a scroll.
Entering from the edge the motion comes from.

SendLevel.description:
One send level: in `source.set_sends`, and in source rows for the levels that
differ from the default (1 to `main`, 0 to every other bus).

bus.description: The bus, by name; `main` is the master mix.

ShapeKind.description: The outline of a picture inside its box (ADR-0053).

oneOf.description: The box, with corners rounded by `radius`.
The largest circle centred in the box.
The ellipse that fills the box.
An isosceles triangle, tip on the top edge of the box.
An arrow pointing toward the right edge of the box.

SourceFault.description:
Why a source cannot deliver (protocol 1.20, ADR-0077). A client treats a value it does
not know as `other`.

oneOf.description: The target is gone: a window closed, a device removed.
The system refused access, or the user has not decided yet.

SourceInfo.description: One source of the program scene.

companion_of.description:
The picture source this one is the "Capture audio too" companion of (protocol
1.26, ADR-0096); absent for other sources.

effective_offset_ms.description:
`h`: the offset the program hears the source's sound at, in milliseconds: the
input's effective offset plus `filter_latency_ms` (protocol 1.77, ADR-0130
decision 4). It equals `sync_offset_ms` while the input's limits and the filter
compensation do not bite. Absent when 0.

filter_latency_ms.description:
`L`: the latency of the source's running audio filters, in milliseconds
(protocol 1.77, ADR-0130; absent when 0).

filters.description: Its filters in chain order (protocol 1.8, ADR-0062; absent when none).

glide.description:
Per-source slide override (protocol 1.35, ADR-0100); absent when the collection
defaults apply.

group.description:
The group the item belongs to in this scene (protocol 1.104, ADR-0182); absent
when it is in none.

heard.description:
What the mix hears while the program scene, in Own levels, has an entry for the
source (protocol 1.48, ADR-0091); absent otherwise, when `volume` and `muted` are
what is heard.

id.description: Its id in the scene collection.

input_late_frames.description:
Output frames of the source's audio input that were silence because its audio
had not arrived (protocol 1.77). Only in `source.list` answers, and only for a
source with a running audio input; the count only grows.

input_resyncs.description:
Times the source's audio input resynchronised (protocol 1.77); present like
`input_late_frames`.

item.description: The id of its item in the program scene (protocol 1.3; absent before).

kind.description:
Its kind; `null` for a type this server cannot name. `image` and `color` are
picture sources (protocol 1.34).

layout.description:
Where its picture is on the studio's canvas; absent for sound-only sources and
before protocol 1.3.

locked.description: The item is locked on the picture panel (protocol 1.6).

mixer_hidden.description:
The source is kept out of the Mixer but still heard (protocol 1.14, ADR-0080;
absent before, meaning shown).

monitor.description:
Whether the source is heard on the monitor output (protocol 1.30, ADR-0097;
absent when off).

name.description: Its name, unique in the collection.

picture_size.description:
Width and height in pixels of the picture it delivers, as last seen while it ran
(protocol 1.5, ADR-0058); absent for sound-only sources and before it ran.

record_separately.description:
The source is marked to record separately (protocol 1.46, ADR-0086); absent
when it is not.

record_tracks.description:
Which feeds are marked, and the picture's form (protocol 1.52, ADR-0117);
absent when none is.

sends.description:
Send levels that differ from the default, 1 to `main` and 0 to other buses
(protocol 1.115, ADR-0097); absent when every level is the default.

sync_offset_ms.description: Sync offset of its sound in milliseconds (protocol 1.8; absent when 0).

uncompensated_ms.description:
The part of `filter_latency_ms` the input's advance limit left uncompensated,
in milliseconds; for a source without an audio input (media, browser audio)
all of it (protocol 1.77; absent when 0).

visible.description: The item is shown (protocol 1.6, ADR-0059; absent before, meaning shown).

volume.description: The source's volume, a linear factor from 0 to 1 (protocol 1.6).

warm_up_ms.description:
Milliseconds from the last time the source became Active to its first picture
(protocol 1.98, ADR-0152 decision 10), for capture sources once one picture
came; kept while the source sleeps. Only in `source.list` answers.
